create_etcdstore: create an EtcdStore instance backed by an etcd client with a configurable prefix and timeout
set_etcdstore_key_value: set a key-value pair in the EtcdStore, encoding both as base64 for binary safety
get_etcdstore_value: get a value from EtcdStore by key with blocking wait until timeout
add_etcdstore_counter: atomically increment a numeric value in EtcdStore using compare-and-swap retry logic
wait_etcdstore_keys: wait for all specified keys to be published in EtcdStore with configurable timeout
